explanation: This page outlines the topics covered in Gene Expression and Regulation. It is structured into three main parts: 1) Prokaryotic Regulation; 2) Eukaryotic Regulation (which covers five levels of control: chromatin structure, transcriptional control, post-transcriptional control, translational control, and post-translational control); and 3) Mutations. It also references an Amoeba Sisters video on Gene Regulation.

questions.q: How many levels of eukaryotic regulation control are listed in the outline on this slide?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide lists 5 sub-points under Eukaryotic Regulation: Chromatin, Transcriptional Control, Post-Transcriptional Control, Translational Control, and Post-Translational Control.
